text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "From positive strides like taking on the Tiara route, to concerns over physical issues and family discord, so much happened during the Classic year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wishing for a safe and healthy run through the Senior Class, I went on a New Year's shrine visit with Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What should I do~?
What should I wish for~?
choice_data_list: Why don't you just ask for all of them?
Why don't you just ask for all of them?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: B-But still...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "It has to be your absolute best, wholehearted beg, or no deal! ...Well, what're you gonna do?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I really want them to reach, so...
I might hesitate for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, Vivlos would probably ask for everything without hesitation, but...
After everything that happened, she seems to be acting more cautiously.
choice_data_list: Then I'll pray for you too.
Then I'll pray on your behalf, too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... they say if you say your wish out loud, it won't come true, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
How should I...
convey my wish?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, Trainy and I are totally in sync, so~.
We'll be just fine♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainie! Give it some real good thought and pray, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I tried to think of a wish for her
that wouldn't overlap with Vivlos's—
choice_data_list: Praying for Vivlos to become a celeb

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I prayed for Vivlos's body to recover,
so she could chase the dreams she envisioned—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy,
you had such a super frantic look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Just a quick peek!
I kinda got curious~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
what did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because it won't come true anymore?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm so curious~... but
I'll hold back!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Trainy wished for it with all their heart, so there's no way I'm gonna ruin that."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I hope it comes true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... Mnh...
—Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer?

For my dearest, most precious you,
I've prepared a top-tier luxury hotel.

For my dearest, most precious you,
I've prepared a top-tier luxury hotel.

This is the love I give to you.
Please, take your time and rest.

This is my gift of love to you.
Please, rest easy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~, oh come on~~~♡
Talking about love and stuff~~♡ You're making me blush♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie, you're seriously the best!
Yep, I'll take a nice, relaxing break!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Trainer-chi. What I really want... is to be with you forever and—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Ehe, ehehe...
Mnya... ehe...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Zzz...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I prayed for Vivlos's success,
so that she could win any race ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes. No matter what trials may come your way,
so that you can overcome them all...
I want you to become strong, strong, stronger...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy, you were looking pretty fired up, huh?
Like you had flames burning behind you.
choice_data_list: I put my whole heart into it, after all...!
I put all my feelings into it, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I kinda had that feeling!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not sure, but
I feel like it's probably not overlapping!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Plus it sounded kind of creepy,
so maybe it's better I didn't hear it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... Mnh...
—Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer?

Let's go, Vivlos!
Dribble like a butterfly, shoot like a bee!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Why?!

You've gotta build physical strength!
It's all about physical strength, Vivlos!

We're building physical strength!
It's all about physical strength, Vivlos!

"I'm gonna get stronger!
Alright, 100 shots, let's go!!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Whatwhatwhatwhat!?
Oh nooo, Trainer-cchi is broken~~!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Ugh... ngh...
I can't hit it anymore...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I mean... you should've gone with baseball there... *snore*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When it comes to Vivlos's core wish, it's definitely being a celebrity... It might overlap, but maybe wishing for it twice will make her twice as glamorous.
choice_data_list: (I hope I can become my ideal self.)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy, weren't you just grinning about something?
choice_data_list: I realized it was kind of a weird wish, even for me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!
What did you wish for!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I wanna check our answers!
choice_data_list: ...Is it really okay to do that?
...Is it really okay to do that?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no good!
I'm curious, but~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it comes true,
will you tell me someday?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... Mnh...
—Lady Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I hear a voice even though nobody's here...
What is that!?

Lady Vivlos. You wished
to become a celebrity.
"And your Trainer wished for you to become a celebrity, too."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?!
We totally share a brain! ♡

So, I shall make you a VIP with double points...
No, 500 times the points, right now.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Does that mean you're a super ultra celebrity!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... Trainy might get mad and say, "Don't fall for sweet talk about high society."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want you to join in on the celeb life too, Trainie!
So a line they might actually agree to would be~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“—Mmggh... As expected...
make it plus 35, please... zzz.”
